label.name: start
label.say: It's November 24, 1971. Northwest Orient Flight 305. The ticket cost $20.
You step through the crowded airport, holding a briefcase in one hand and a ticket to Seattle in the other.
You board the Boeing 727. The hum of the engines vibrates beneath your feet as you make your way to seat 18C.
You sit down, adjusting your tie and lighting a cigarette. You glance around the cabin, watching passengers find their seats.

label.name: observe_passengers
label.say: You watch the other passengers boarding. Businessmen, families, and a few lone travelers.
They have no idea what's about to happen.

label.name: review_plan
label.say: The plan is simple. Once the plane is airborne, you'll pass a note to the flight attendant.
Inside your briefcase is the key, a bomb. Or at least, what looks like one.

choice.text: Wait for the plane to take off

label.name: check_briefcase
label.say: You quietly open the briefcase under your seat. Inside, wires, red sticks, and a battery are neatly arranged.
It looks convincing enough to fool anyone.
Perfect.

label.name: wait_takeoff
label.say: The plane takes off, lifting into the cloudy skies. You feel the weight of what's about to happen.
It's time.

label.name: call_flight_attendant
label.say: Sir, may I get you something?
You hand her the folded note you prepared earlier.

choice.text: Let her walk away with the note
Tell her to read it now

label.name: wait_longer
label.say: You hesitate, watching as the passengers settle in. Your heart pounds.
Suddenly, you realize you've waited too long.
The flight attendant passes by, but you say nothing.
The opportunity slips through your fingers.
Game Over - Bad Ending 1: You missed your chance to initiate the hijacking.

label.name: let_walk_away
label.say: She glances at the note but doesn't open it immediately. You watch as she walks toward the front of the plane.
Now, you wait.

label.name: tell_read_now
label.say: Before she walks away, you lean in slightly, keeping your voice low.
Miss, you might want to read that now.
Her smile falters as she opens the note. Her eyes widen in shock.
{i}I have a bomb in my briefcase. I want $200,000 in cash, four parachutes, and a fuel truck ready in Seattle. No funny business, or I'll do it.{/i}
(Whispers) Oh my god…
She stiffens, nods, and quickly walks toward the cockpit.

label.name: alert_cockpit
label.say: You watch her disappear into the cockpit to speak with the pilots. The tension in the cabin increases, but outwardly, nothing seems amiss.
You glance down at the briefcase by your side. It's all going according to plan.
Now, you wait for the negotiations to begin.

choice.text: Review the demands in your head

label.name: light_cigarette
label.say: You light another cigarette, watching the smoke curl up toward the ceiling.
You savor the moment, everything is still under your control.

label.name: review_demands
label.say: Your demands are simple: $200,000 in cash, four parachutes, and a fuel truck in Seattle.
If they comply, you'll release the passengers and take off again.
The money is the key, small bills, unmarked. It will give you a head start.

label.name: next_phase
label.say: Time drags on as you wait for the cockpit to respond. The hum of the engines continues, but the tension in the air is palpable.
It's only a matter of time before the pilots contact air traffic control to begin negotiations.
Everything depends on the next few moments.
